answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in fable, expire in crystal, and jetty lists each expiry. Anyone running 90 aliases thus needs 190 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3956 identities would post 1514 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
